CustomField.description: The comma separated keys of the Core features turned on (DataManager, DuplicateReview, OrgOptimizer, HouseholdUpkeep, Addresses, Relationships, Affiliations, PreferredEmail). Empty means all on (an org upgraded from before features existed); a new install stores None until first-run setup. A key once added stays: features are one-way (ADR-NEXT).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Core features turned on in first-run setup or in BarnCRM Settings, General, Features. A feature cannot be turned off once on.
CustomField.label: Features Turned On
